It's really good.
I always find the vibe at reception a bit weird but the actual dental lady is good. Really gentle. Even gave me numbing for the clean.
Prices pretty good.
EDIT:
Walked in just after opening the other day [30/11] to find reception unnattended and not a soul around so ended up changing clinics. Not the first time this happened. I feel reception here could really be improved.

Two months ago, I had two fillings done here. When I got home, the fillings felt very uncomfortable. At the end of the appointment, the dentist didn’t ask me if the fillings felt too high or check my bite, as is usually done. Had to make another appointment to fix this, and I also felt pressure between my teeth. But my complaints about this uncomfortable pressure were laughed at and the doctor did nothing, saying that everything was fine.

Now it’s been two months, and I still can’t chew properly with those teeth - every time I try, the gums around the fillings get inflamed. I’m not a dentist, but this really doesn’t seem “fine”.

I also feel that one of the fillings was done completely unnecessarily. Only after the appointment did I realize that three different dentists from other clinics had seen my x-rays and never mentioned anything about that second tooth. The cavity that needed treatment was on one tooth. So be prepared, they might try to sell you fillings you don’t even need.

The clinic is bright and clean, and everyone speaks English. When I made my appointment, they asked if I wanted a female or male doctor.

A teeth cleaning with airflow costs 1,700 baht, and everything was done very carefully and efficiently.

I had a dental cleaning, and they cleaned very thoroughly (airflow, dental floss, polishing). My lips were moisturized during the procedure. The dentist speaks English well. Prices are listed on the website. Good service, highly recommend.

The doctor is cute, the assistant is very cute and playful, but the receptionist or cashier, from when I called to inquire or make an appointment with the doctor, until I saw his face, both his facial expression and tone of voice were not appropriate for the receptionist at all. 🙁😬 Or is he discriminating? …
